candidate.selection_reason: Executes replacement of function/regexp placeholders using the dynamic UID-based regexp, directly performing deserialization.
candidate.source_summary: User-provided object containing functions and regexps that get serialized. The serialize function processes arbitrary JavaScript objects.
candidate.sink_summary: Output string containing executable JavaScript code (function and regexp literals) that may be evaluated with eval() in client-side contexts.
candidate.guard_summary: UID-based regexp pattern makes placeholder guessing harder; native function detection prevents serialization of built-ins; unsafe character escaping for HTML/JavaScript safety.
candidate.risk_pattern: Serialization of user-provided functions and regexps into executable code strings that may be evaluated in unsafe contexts, potentially enabling code injection.
candidate.context_summary: The serialize function converts JavaScript objects to strings, replacing functions and regexps with their string representations. The candidate line performs the final placeholder replacement that converts serialized placeholders back to executable code strings.

target_cwe.cwe_name: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')
target_cwe.description: The product constructs all or part of a code segment using externally-influenced input from an upstream component, but it does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes special elements that could modify the syntax or behavior of the intended code segment. Common in: input_validation.
remediation_steps: Use parameterized queries and prepared statements
Implement strict input validation with whitelisting
